$Comment: What the Great Turkey's Boss Kill Claim on the hard way in (Rewards/Harvest_Feast/
Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Chase_Hard) pays, on every hard win: Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Chase.json's
rolls at better amounts and odds. Every roll is read on its own: the first two always pay, the last four
The first roll pays Harvest Coins and festival tokens through the Currency reward kind, the second two
pumpkin pies. Then a better chance at one of Martha's Turkey Pies, the same chance at a Wishbone back as
the normal Claim, the Great Turkey Mantle (Item/Items/Harvest_Feast/Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Mantle.json)
at better than twice the normal odds and the Golden Turkey Trophy at three times them. The Wishbone stays
at the normal Claim's chance on purpose: the Claim is not scaled by share, so every player who fought it
rolls the Wishbone on its own, and a full party must spend more Wishbones than it wins back, or the hard
graveyard pays for its own way in. The Almanac's Boss Kill grid
(ZiggfreedCommon/Almanac/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast.json) lists what both tables pay, so change them
together. Favor with Martha is not here: favor rides a quest's or a contract's own Rewards, never a pay
table. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100. A companion mod adds rolls with a file naming this table in
Name: Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Chase_Hard
